finding.headline: "The C-Section Shelf That Won't Flatten"
finding.problem: "My belly looks like a ledge. Every fitted top I try shows the shelf. I'm scared if I exercise I'll tear something inside — but I hate this lump that wasn't there before."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — BODY CONFIDENCE + GETTING DRESSED AGAIN
finding.person: Amaka, 31, Lagos, 11 weeks post emergency C-section (2nd baby), incision healed but a hard "shelf" of puffiness sits above the scar; wants to wear her wrapper/gele to an upcoming owambe but the bulge shows through.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (C-section recovery + scar-confidence system)". Verdict: PASSES (21/25).
